description: Scanning the demo-codex fixture under the auto-detected codex lens (the `.codex/` marker resolves it unambiguously) classifies the three `.codex/agents/*.toml` files as codex/agent and the four markdown files (AGENTS.md, the two docs, the note) via the core/markdown fallback. Seven nodes, no issues: a TOML-only agent corpus plus its referenced docs resolves into a clean graph.
